name: Cricket Arabia
summary: Social media post design and promotional content for a cricket equipment and sports e-commerce brand.
identity: Strong red, black and white sports-inspired design, cinematic compositions, bold typography and product-focused presentation.
contribution: Social media posts, carousels, website banners, promotional campaigns and AI-assisted video content.

categoryNotes.web-banners: Horizontal e-commerce banners, new-arrival promotions and homepage collection graphics.
categoryNotes.videos: Product-focused content, short-form marketing videos and AI-assisted edits.
categoryNotes.campaigns: Flash sales, seasonal and festival offers, Independence Day promotions and product campaigns.
